name: Oxiracetam
addictionPotential: non-addictive with a low potential for abuse
toxicity: safe even when high doses are consumed for a long period of time
summary: Oxiracetam is a racetam nootropic, having a hydroxyl group being the only difference between this and piracetam. It used as a nootropic, namely for increased cognitive function. It is typically used two to three times a day. This substance is typically taken with choline and is reported to cause headaches without the addition of it.
advisory: This is for the course over a 24 hour period. 2-3x times daily, such as 400mg-800mg/3x day.
doseBasis: Note: This is for the course over a 24 hour period. 2-3x times daily, such as 400mg-800mg/3x day.

tolerance.buildUp: develops with prolonged and repeated use

uses.text: Oxiracetam is not approved by Food and Drug Administration for any medical use in the United States.

summaryZh: 奧拉西坦（英語：Oxiracetam，開發代號：ISF 2522）是一種有機化合物，化學式C6H10N2O3，有微弱的興奮劑作用，可作為益智藥。

sideEffects.en: Reported effects include headache, restlessness and trouble sleeping. Its long-term effects in healthy people have not been well studied.
sideEffects.zh: 已報告的作用包括頭痛、躁動不安與睡眠困難。它對健康人長期的影響尚無充分研究。
sideEffects.zhHans: 已报告的作用包括头痛、躁动不安与睡眠困难。它对健康人长期的影响尚无充分研究。

fact.en: Oxiracetam is piracetam with one hydroxyl group added, and that is the only difference between the two molecules.
fact.zh: 奧拉西坦是在吡拉西坦上加了一個羥基，這也是兩個分子之間唯一的差別。
fact.zhHans: 奥拉西坦是在吡拉西坦上加了一个羟基，这也是两个分子之间唯一的差别。
